config.subset: sort train person_id by sha256(f'{seed}:{person_id}'); take ceil(fraction*85); no label stratification, no resampling
config.source: earlier frozen Humans HNE-additive; no Human Rhythms source refit
config.parameter_prior: unchanged SourcePriorWarning; raw-logit source or zero coefficient center; intercept unpenalized; target-prior correction
config.full_target_only: reuse existing frozen Human Rhythms HNE-additive model and scores, without another fit
config.selection: maximum validation AUROC; single-class negative logloss; exact ties smaller C
config.weighting: equal target training-person base mass, then class balance
config.threshold: linear90th percentile of finite validation negative scores; alert strictly greater than threshold
config.seed_summary: mean of three independently selected subset-seed metrics, not an ensemble; 100% one fit; fixed-subset-seed person bootstrap averages the same resampled-person metrics
